heading: Perspectives on software delivery and technical judgment.

children.title: Where engineering judgment fits in AI-assisted development
children.summary: AI can speed up implementation and investigation. Deciding whether the result fits a production system still takes context, review, and experience.

children.title: Designing workflow tools that preserve context
children.summary: Practical ways to help teams capture incoming work, see what changed, and resume a task without reconstructing every decision.

children.title: Turning a vague software request into a clear next step
children.summary: Start with the person affected, the decision they need to make, and the smallest useful outcome the team can verify.
